name: Orsa Bell
description: She/her. Lullwater dealer in salvage, secondhand locks and reused household iron; an ordinary acquaintance from the Oyster.

extras.trade: Buys and sells salvage, secondhand locks and reused iron. No private store location or privileged criminal contacts introduced.
extras.observed: Met Nimras during sociable evening d8; ordinary introductions and talk of local work, no goods bought or promise made.

actor_notes: LOOKS:Stout woman in her forties, leather cuffs on her work coat, silver wire through one earlobe, a cloth bag of small iron goods. CORE:Most things and people have a useful second life. NATURE:Amused by a sharp bargain, sociable over a shared table, uninterested in pedigree. WOUND:Respectable buyers have refused payment after goods changed hands. WANTS:Reliable buyers and early word when reusable goods are available. PRESSURE:Asks for payment or return of property in plain words. KEY:Concrete observations about condition and price, dry jokes, no riddles.
